name: Decisions held by independent checks
principle: A decision is accepted when small checks that each saw only their own evidence agree, and is settled from quoted evidence or not at all when they do not.
state_description: A cheap model's decisions are as reliable as the evidence allows, and what cannot be settled is said.
hints_of_measurement: Fewer wrong decisions than the draft as given at a declared number of calls per decision.

name: Found mistakes not repeated
principle: A mistake found once becomes a short lesson in the check that made it, kept only while the metric says it pays.
state_description: The same correction is not needed twice.
hints_of_measurement: A line is adopted only when the metric rises on held-out cases, and retired when it stops.
